base.name: Capital
base.desc: Destroy the enemy capital to win. Protect yours!

rifleman.name: M4 Rifleman
rifleman.desc: Infantry. Cheap frontline infantry. Weak against armor.

assault.name: SCAR-H Assault
assault.desc: Assault infantry. Fast SMG trooper. Deadly up close, short range.

bazooka.name: Carl Gustaf Trooper
bazooka.desc: Anti-tank infantry. Anti-tank rockets. Excellent against vehicles.

mg_gunner.name: M240 Machine Gunner
mg_gunner.desc: Machine gunner. Slow but pours out suppressive fire.

grenadier.name: M320 Grenadier
grenadier.desc: Grenadier. Lobs grenades. Splash damage against groups.

sniper.name: M82 Barrett Sniper
sniper.desc: Sniper. One shot, one kill - against infantry. Useless against armor.

flamer.name: M2 Flamethrower
flamer.desc: Flamethrower trooper. Burns infantry and buildings at point-blank range.

medic.name: CLS Combat Medic
medic.desc: Medic. Heals nearby infantry. Follows the army.

commando.name: Delta Force SOF
commando.desc: Special forces. Elite operative. Armor-piercing rifle, tough and fast.

jeep.name: HMMWV Humvee
jeep.desc: Scout vehicle. Fast raider with a machine gun. Shreds infantry.

armored_car.name: LAV-25 Scout Car
armored_car.desc: Armored car. Fast recon vehicle with an autocannon.

apc.name: M2 Bradley IFV
apc.desc: Infantry fighting vehicle. Armored carrier. Unloads troops when destroyed.

heavy_tank.name: Leopard 2A7 Tank
heavy_tank.desc: Heavy main battle tank. Slow, nearly unstoppable armor.

mammoth.name: T-14 Armata Tank
mammoth.desc: Super-heavy tank. Twin-cannon super-heavy. Crushes buildings.

tank_destroyer.name: B1 Centauro TD
tank_destroyer.desc: Tank destroyer. Long-range hunter of armor. Poor against infantry.

flame_tank.name: M132 Flame Tank
flame_tank.desc: Flame tank. Short-range inferno. Melts infantry and buildings.

artillery.name: M109 Paladin SPG
artillery.desc: Self-propelled gun. Long-range splash damage. Cannot hit close targets.

howitzer.name: PzH 2000 Howitzer
howitzer.desc: Heavy howitzer. Huge range. Needs a Radar Station for spotting.

mlrs.name: M142 HIMARS
mlrs.desc: Rocket artillery. Multiple-launch rocket system: rapid area bombardment.

aa_truck.name: M1097 Avenger AA
aa_truck.desc: Mobile anti-air. Rapid-fire flak against aircraft.

sam_truck.name: Patriot PAC-3 SAM
sam_truck.desc: Mobile SAM launcher. Long-range anti-air missiles.

repair_vehicle.name: M88 Hercules ARV
repair_vehicle.desc: Recovery & repair vehicle. Repairs nearby vehicles and tanks. Follows the army.

drone.name: Switchblade Drone
drone.desc: Kamikaze drone. Cheap suicide drone. Explodes on the first ground target.

fighter.name: F-16 Fighting Falcon
fighter.desc: Multirole fighter. Fast multirole fighter. Dominates the sky.

interceptor_jet.name: F-15C Eagle
interceptor_jet.desc: Air superiority fighter. Hunts enemy aircraft only. Very fast.

stealth_fighter.name: F-22 Raptor Stealth
stealth_fighter.desc: Stealth fighter. Nearly invisible: enemies only see it at close range.

strike_jet.name: F-15E Strike Eagle
strike_jet.desc: Strike fighter. Ground-attack jet with armor-piercing cannon.

helicopter.name: AH-64E Apache
helicopter.desc: Attack helicopter. Tough gunship armed with rockets. Drops depth charges on submarines and divers.

gunship.name: AC-130J Ghostrider
gunship.desc: Heavy gunship. Flying fortress. Rockets with splash.

light_bomber.name: Su-34 Fullback
light_bomber.desc: Fighter-bomber. Fast bombing runs over the battlefield.

bomber.name: B-1B Lancer Bomber
bomber.desc: Supersonic bomber. Flies bombing runs over the battlefield. Needs anti-air cover.

heavy_bomber.name: B-52 Stratofortress
heavy_bomber.desc: Strategic bomber. Carpet-bombs everything below. Wrecks buildings.

stealth_bomber.name: B-2 Stealth Bomber
stealth_bomber.desc: Stealth bomber. Invisible until it is overhead. Devastating payload.

diver.name: Navy SEAL Diver
diver.desc: Combat diver. Frogman. Walks on land, swims unseen underwater and plants limpet mines. Deadly to ships.

patrol_boat.name: Mk VI Patrol Boat
patrol_boat.desc: Patrol boat. Fast machine-gun skiff. Sails rivers and sea. Weak against anything heavy.

gunboat.name: CB90 Assault Boat
gunboat.desc: River gunboat. Small cannon boat. Sails rivers and sea and shells coastal targets.

missile_boat.name: Hamina Missile Boat
missile_boat.desc: Missile boat. Guided rockets: strong against aircraft and ships. Needs a river or sea.

destroyer.name: Arleigh Burke DDG
destroyer.desc: Guided-missile destroyer. Versatile warship. Guns for land and air, depth charges for submarines and divers.

cruiser.name: Ticonderoga Cruiser
cruiser.desc: Guided-missile cruiser. Heavy gun cruiser. Long range, strong armor. Deep sea only.

battleship.name: USS Iowa Battleship
battleship.desc: Battleship. Huge guns that flatten coastal cities. Slow and costly. Deep sea only.

submarine.name: Virginia Class Sub
submarine.desc: Attack submarine. Submerged hunter. Torpedoes cripple ships. Only destroyers, helicopters and other subs can hit it.

aircraft_carrier.name: USS Nimitz Carrier
aircraft_carrier.desc: Aircraft carrier. Floating airbase: launches free aircraft and lets you build aircraft without an Airbase. Shoots down planes and missiles. Deep sea only.

pillbox.name: Hardened Pillbox
pillbox.desc: Pillbox. Concrete machine-gun nest. Hard to kill.

at_gun.name: TOW-2 AT Emplacement
at_gun.desc: Anti-tank emplacement. Armor-piercing gun. Deadly to tanks.

cannon_turret.name: M68 105mm Bunker
cannon_turret.desc: Cannon bunker. Armored bunker with a heavy cannon.

mortar_pit.name: M252 Mortar Pit
mortar_pit.desc: Mortar pit. Indirect fire over walls. Cannot hit close targets.

flak_battery.name: Oerlikon Skynex Flak
flak_battery.desc: Flak battery. Airburst flak shreds groups of aircraft.

sam_site.name: NASAMS SAM Site
sam_site.desc: SAM site. Surface-to-air missiles. Needs power; radar extends its range.

heavy_battery.name: M777 155mm Battery
heavy_battery.desc: Heavy artillery battery. Fixed long-range artillery battery.

railgun.name: ONR EMRG Railgun
railgun.desc: Railgun battery. Hyper-velocity gun. Pierces any armor. Needs power.

ciws.name: Mk 15 Phalanx CIWS
ciws.desc: Close-in weapon system. Rapid-fire point defense against aircraft and missiles. Needs power.

interceptor_battery.name: Iron Dome Battery
interceptor_battery.desc: Missile interceptor. Shoots down incoming missiles and nukes. Needs power; radar extends range.

abm_battery.name: THAAD ABM Battery
abm_battery.desc: Anti-ballistic missile battery. Long-range anti-ballistic system. Double-strength interceptors.

barricade.name: Jersey Barrier
barricade.desc: Barricade. Cheap wall that soaks up fire.

repair_depot.name: Field Repair Depot
repair_depot.desc: Repair depot. Repairs friendly vehicles and buildings nearby. Needs power.

coastal_battery.name: NSM Coastal Battery
coastal_battery.desc: Coastal defense battery. Shore gun that only fires at ships, subs and divers in the water. Build near the coast.

oil_refinery.name: Oil Refinery
oil_refinery.desc: +3 income per second. Explodes when destroyed.

power_plant.name: Power Plant
power_plant.desc: Powers SAMs, interceptors, railguns, CIWS and radars.

barracks.name: Barracks
barracks.desc: Unlocks elite infantry and trains free troops.

factory.name: War Factory
factory.desc: Unlocks heavy vehicles and builds free light vehicles.

airbase.name: Airbase
airbase.desc: Required for all aircraft. Scrambles free drones and fighters.

radar_station.name: Radar Station
radar_station.desc: Extends SAM and interceptor range. Spots for howitzers.

missile_silo.name: Missile Silo
missile_silo.desc: Required for ballistic missiles and nukes. Launches from here.

tech_center.name: Tech Center
tech_center.desc: Unlocks stealth aircraft, super-heavy armor, ABMs and doomsday weapons.

fortress.name: Fortress
fortress.desc: Massive stronghold with a heavy cannon.

naval_port.name: Naval Port
naval_port.desc: Unlocks boats, ships and subs. Must be on the coast. Launches free patrol boats and gunboats.

tactical_missile.name: M39 ATACMS
tactical_missile.desc: Tactical missile. Cheap and quick. Light blast.

cruise_missile.name: BGM-109 Tomahawk
cruise_missile.desc: Cruise missile. Fast, precise and cheap. Easy for interceptors to kill (1 hit).

cluster_missile.name: Iskander-M Cluster
cluster_missile.desc: Cluster missile. Wide blast: great against massed troops.

bunker_buster.name: GBU-57 Bunker Buster
bunker_buster.desc: Bunker buster. Pierces armor. Triple damage against buildings.

ballistic_missile.name: Pershing II Missile
ballistic_missile.desc: Ballistic missile. Heavy warhead that wipes out clusters. Needs 2 interceptor hits.

hypersonic.name: Kh-47M2 Kinzhal
hypersonic.desc: Hypersonic missile. Brutally fast. Almost no time to react.

tactical_nuke.name: B61 Tactical Nuke
tactical_nuke.desc: Tactical nuke. A smaller nuclear warhead. Erases a city block.

nuke.name: LGM-30 Minuteman III
nuke.desc: Nuclear ICBM. Devastating. Obliterates everything in a huge radius. Needs 3 interceptor hits.

mega_nuke.name: RDS-220 Tsar Bomba
mega_nuke.desc: Doomsday device. Annihilates an entire region. The end of the world.

wehrmacht.name: Wehrmacht
wehrmacht.desc: German combined-arms doctrine: expensive, tough armor, terror-bombers and rocket science. Tech-tier slots use late-war prototypes (Maus, Me 262, Ho 229, V-weapons).

blitzkrieg.name: Blitzkrieg
blitzkrieg.desc: Fast armor and Stukas hit before you can dig in. Starts with a panzer spearhead.

westwall.name: Westwall
westwall.desc: Concrete, flak and 88s. Starts with a fortified front line.

wunderwaffen.name: Wunderwaffen
wunderwaffen.desc: Rockets and experimental superweapons, built cheap and fired often.

red_army.name: Red Army
red_army.tagline: Quantity has a quality all its own.
red_army.desc: Soviet mass mobilisation: cheap infantry, rocket artillery and sturdy tanks. Pricier air force and no aircraft carriers.

deep_battle.name: Deep Battle
deep_battle.desc: Massed artillery and Katyushas soften the line. Starts with a rocket park.

human_wave.name: Human Wave
human_wave.desc: Endless cheap riflemen. Starts with a huge infantry horde.

kursk.name: Kursk Salient
kursk.desc: Layered anti-tank belts. Starts with AT guns, pillboxes and mortars.

ija.name: Imperial Japanese Army
ija.desc: Fanatical infantry, island fortresses and suicide weapons. Tanks are weak and aircraft cost more; the Combined Fleet lends its ships.

banzai.name: Banzai Charge
banzai.desc: Fast, cheap, fanatical infantry. Starts with a screaming horde.

island_fortress.name: Island Fortress
island_fortress.desc: Tunnels and cave pillboxes. Starts with a hardened front and coastal guns.

combined_fleet.name: Combined Fleet
combined_fleet.desc: Lean on the navy. Starts with warships in your waters.

british_army.name: British Army
british_army.desc: Modern British forces: hardy infantry, strong air defense and the Royal Navy to back them up.

combined_arms.name: Combined Arms
combined_arms.desc: Balanced armor and infantry at a discount. Starts with a mixed task force.

fortress_britain.name: Fortress Britain
fortress_britain.desc: An air-defense umbrella. Starts with SAMs, CIWS and interceptors.

naval_supremacy.name: Royal Navy Supremacy
naval_supremacy.desc: Rule the waves. Starts with warships and cheaper fleet.

us_army.name: US Army
us_army.desc: Modern American forces: the default roster, with cheaper aircraft and missiles and a stronger economy.

air_supremacy.name: Air Supremacy
air_supremacy.desc: Fast, cheap aircraft. Starts with fighters, a strike jet and a SAM.

arsenal.name: Arsenal of Democracy
arsenal.desc: Bigger economy and cheaper armor. Starts with an armored task force.

shock_awe.name: Shock and Awe
shock_awe.desc: Missile-heavy: cheap, fast-recharging strikes. Starts with a missile shield.

french_army.name: French Army
french_army.tagline: Fortress, legion, and force de frappe.
french_army.desc: Modern French forces: agile infantry, cheaper strategic weapons, sturdy fortifications. A leaner economy.

maginot.name: Ligne Maginot
maginot.desc: Concrete forts everywhere. Starts with a hardened front line.

force_de_frappe.name: Force de Frappe
force_de_frappe.desc: Independent nuclear deterrent: cheap, fast-recharging strategic weapons.

legion.name: Legion Etrangere
legion.desc: Tough, cheap elite infantry. Starts with legionnaires and commandos.

italian_army.name: Italian Royal Army
italian_army.desc: Regio Esercito: speedy Bersaglieri and a good navy, but lighter tanks and a thin economy. No rocket artillery, drones, helicopters or stealth bomber.

ariete.name: Ariete Armoured
ariete.desc: Light fast armor and armored cars. Starts with a mobile column.

alpini.name: Alpini Mountain Defense
alpini.desc: Dug-in alpine strongpoints. Starts with pillboxes, AT guns and mortars.

regia_marina.name: Regia Marina
regia_marina.desc: Mediterranean sea power. Starts with a small fleet.

russian_gf.name: Russian Ground Forces
russian_gf.tagline: The god of war is artillery.
russian_gf.desc: Modern Russian doctrine: cheap artillery and rockets, tough vehicles, layered air defense.

missile_doctrine.name: Missile & Artillery
missile_doctrine.desc: Rockets and guns win wars. Cheap strikes; starts with rocket artillery.

layered_ad.name: Layered Air Defense
layered_ad.desc: S-400 umbrella. Starts with SAMs, CIWS and interceptors.

armored_wedge.name: Armored Wedge
armored_wedge.desc: Cheaper, tougher armor. Starts with a tank spearhead.
